blocks.prompt: 4 (i) Find the first five terms of each sequence described: \(a_1 = 243,\ r = \frac{1}{3}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is mein pehla term aur common ratio dono de diye gaye hain, bas terms likhne hain.
Diya kya hai? \(a_1 = 243\), \(r = \frac{1}{3}\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehle paanch terms.
Plan: har term ko \(\frac{1}{3}\) se multiply karte jayenge, yani 3 se divide karte jayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 243\), \(r = \frac{1}{3}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a_1\) se \(a_5\) tak.
Tareeqa: G.P. ki definition hi yeh hai ke agla term = pichla term \(\times r\), yani \(a_{n+1} = a_n \cdot r\). Paanch terms ke liye formula ki bajaye seedha multiply karna zyada aasaan hai.

Har dafa \(\frac{1}{3}\) se multiply karein
\[a_2 = 243 \cdot \tfrac{1}{3} = 81\]
\[a_3 = 81 \cdot \tfrac{1}{3} = 27\]
\[a_4 = 27 \cdot \tfrac{1}{3} = 9\]
\[a_5 = 9 \cdot \tfrac{1}{3} = 3\]
Kyun: Kisi number ko \(\frac{1}{3}\) se multiply karna aur 3 se divide karna ek hi baat hai. 243 teen ki power hai (\(3^5\)), is liye har term saaf whole number aata hai.

Tasdeeq: formula se 5th term
\[a_5 = 243\left(\tfrac{1}{3}\right)^{4} = \dfrac{243}{81} = 3\]
Kyun: Formula \(a_5 = a_1 r^{4}\) ne bhi wohi 3 diya jo list ne diya, is liye hamari list sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (ii) Find the first five terms of each sequence described: \(a_1 = 579,\ r = -\frac{1}{2}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa common ratio negative hai: \(r = -\frac{1}{2}\).
Diya kya hai? \(a_1 = 579\) aur \(r\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehle paanch terms.
Plan: har term ko \(-\frac{1}{2}\) se multiply karenge. Negative ratio ka matlab hai ke signs baari baari badlenge: plus, minus, plus, minus.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = 579\), \(r = -\frac{1}{2}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a_1\) se \(a_5\) tak.
Tareeqa: Agla term = pichla term \(\times r\). Negative \(r\) wali G.P. ko alternating G.P. bhi kehte hain, kyunke is ke terms ka sign har qadam par ulat jata hai.

Har dafa \(-\frac{1}{2}\) se multiply karein
\[a_2 = 579\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\dfrac{579}{2}\]
\[a_3 = -\dfrac{579}{2}\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = \dfrac{579}{4}\]
\[a_4 = -\dfrac{579}{8}\]
\[a_5 = \dfrac{579}{16}\]
Kyun: Har qadam par do kaam hote hain: size aadha hota hai (denominator 2, 4, 8, 16 banta hai) aur sign ulat jata hai. Minus ko minus se multiply karein to plus, is liye \(a_3\) positive hai. 579 odd number hai, is liye fractions ko chhota nahi kar sakte; unhein waise hi chhor dete hain.
Dhyan dein: Sign badalna mat bhooliye; sab terms positive likhna aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: formula se 5th term
\[a_5 = 579\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{4} = \dfrac{579}{16}\]
Kyun: Negative number ki even power (jaise 4) hamesha positive hoti hai, is liye \(a_5\) positive aaya, bilkul list ki tarah. Odd position wale terms positive aur even position wale negative hain.
